sahneler.metin: At night off Japan, a container ship slammed into the destroyer Fitzgerald.
Seawater flooded crew berthing, and seven sailors were killed.
The bridge team lost track of the ships around them.
An order to turn and speed up came late.
It wasn't carried out in time.
The Navy overhauled training in its Pacific fleet.

aciklama:
USS Fitzgerald collided with a container ship off Japan. The cause: late recognition of a crossing ship and orders that were not carried out.
